name: agents-sdk
title_zh: 调试 Cloudflare Agents 时能直接看
tagline_zh: 写 Agents SDK 代码时，不用再靠 console.log 猜状态。装了这个 skill。
tagline_en: Stop guessing with console.log. This skill adds a live inspector to see every step, tool call, and memory of your.
desc_en: Build, debug, or review Cloudflare Agents SDK applications using the agents package.
why_zh: 它把调试从黑盒变成白盒：直接复用 agents 包的内部钩子，在浏览器里实时展示状态流转，比日志快十倍。
why_en: Turns debugging from black-box to glass-box: hooks into the agents package internals to stream state changes live in the.
limit_zh: 只适用于 Cloudflare Agents SDK 项目（agents 包），且需在本地开发服务器运行。
limit_en: Only for Cloudflare Agents SDK projects (agents package) running in local dev server. Not for production or remote workers. Output is a browser.
title_en: Debug Cloudflare Agents with an in-browser inspector
